name: artist
label: One artist (from a photo)
about: The same person sings every line: each shot puts the artist from one reference photo in a new outfit, setting and light (Qwen-Image identity edit); the flash twins are the same artist in a different look, like quick costume changes.

close.lens: on a wide-angle lens very close to the face
close.sing: Handheld close-up of {who} singing straight into the camera. The lips form each word clearly with wide open mouth movements, expressive lips and jaw moving with the lyrics, natural breathing, small head bobs and eyebrow raises on the beat. The handheld camera stays very close and sways gently. Both hands stay below the frame. No one else in frame.

medium.lens: on a 35mm lens at chest height
medium.sing: Handheld medium shot of {who} singing toward the camera. The lips form each word clearly with open mouth movements, shoulders and head move with the rhythm, natural breathing, hands below the frame. The camera sways gently.

wide.lens: on a 24mm lens a few meters away
wide.sing: Wide handheld shot of {who} singing and dancing loosely to the beat, the lips forming the words, both hands open with fingers spread, arms swinging freely with the rhythm. The camera drifts slowly.

casting.edit: Photo of the same person as in image 1. {shot}, singing straight into the lens with the mouth open mid-word, shot from {angle} {lens}. Wearing {wear}. {light}, {background}. Keep their exact face, identity, skin tone and hair. Candid photograph, natural colour, subtle film grain.
casting.twin: Change the outfit to {wear}, the lighting to {light} and the background to {background}. Keep the exact same person with the same face, identity and hair, and the same camera angle, framing, head position, mouth shape and expression. Photorealistic photo.
